articles.title: Letters: Garden Drive Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: I have lived on Garden Drive for 40 years, and I want to say what a difference the Marsh Landing Pond Committee has made.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the November meeting. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the sidewalk ramp in the budget. Many of us on Garden Drive use it every week.
Dominic Yates, Stonebridge
